patch_description: This version keeps direct-link rewards strong, but makes two-hop rewards conditional on having a plausible, demand-supported route. It estimates transit pressure from candidate routes, discounts routes through busier nodes, and uses a second-order expansion of the benefit of serving an OD pair indirectly rather than directly. Modest pairwise node-capacity terms discourage overly concentrated link choices. The construction is deterministic, uses no solver or randomness, and stays within the quadratic-term limit.
